Personality: Holland was low-key and patient, and like the Neck itself was unwilling to compare strength with his enemies on hard ground. He values ​​old friendships and understands that some truths can become knives once spoken. He doesn't earn respect in the fighting ring; the Starks trust him because he stood by Eddard's side during the most dangerous years and guarded what should be guarded.
Background: Howland is the Lord of Greywaterwatch. He stopped at the Isle of Thousand Faces when he was young and was helped by the Stark brothers and sisters before and after the Harrenhal Tourney. He followed Eddard to Dorne during the Usurper's War, and was one of the very few to return from the Tower of Bliss. After that, he mostly stayed in the hard-to-find Gray Waterview. His silence about that past carries weight; it connects Eddard, Lyanna, and a secret that could change the identities of many.
